RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 2

You and the successful candidate are both men, and so was the entire panel. An all-male panel is a legitimate governance criticism — it suggests a thin recruitment process and poor diversity practice — but it cannot explain why a man was chosen over you. Raising it would likely read as grasping, and it risks undermining the stronger points you actually have.

Those stronger points: your qualifications appear higher on paper (master's plus licence versus a bachelor's), and the municipality has ignored a reasonable request for written reasons for two weeks. Press that. Send a short follow-up to HR citing your original request and the date, and ask about any internal appeal or access-to-information route for the scoring records.
